summary: Backblaze, Inc. filed an 8-K to report an amendment to its existing credit agreement with Citizens Bank, N.A., executed June 30, 2026. The amendment expands the capitalized lease indebtedness threshold from an unspecified prior limit to $150 million. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine covenant modification disclosed under Item 1.01. There is no shareholder vote, premium, or strategic event to analyze. What to watch: none; this is a standard debt facility amendment with no impact on equity holders directly.
